adFormat.description: Spark ads or Non-Spark ads; omitted when the board did not reveal it
adFormat.title: Ad Format

adSource.description: TikTok Ads Manager or Others, from the ad detail
adSource.title: Ad Source

adUrl.description: Creative Center reference URL with the ad_id query parameter (TikTok redirects ad deep links to the dashboard)
adUrl.title: Ad URL

availableTotal.description: TikTok's ranked-index size for the base query
availableTotal.title: Available Total

brandName.description: Advertiser/brand name when TikTok publishes it; sentinel values are omitted
brandName.title: Brand Name

commentCount.description: Comment count from the ad detail; 0 is a real value
commentCount.title: Comments

cost.description: TikTok budget tier: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high
cost.title: Cost Tier Code

creativeCenterUrl.description: Canonical Creative Center ad URL in the form /topads/<id>/pc/en
creativeCenterUrl.title: Creative Center URL

ctr.description: TikTok CTR score in percent units (0.62 means 0.62%)
ctr.title: CTR

detailUnavailable.description: True when a requested ad ID has no detail record
detailUnavailable.title: Detail Unavailable

detailsFetched.description: Present when detail enrichment was requested
detailsFetched.title: Details Fetched

foundInCountry.description: Market whose board surfaced the ad
foundInCountry.title: Found In Country

industryKey.description: Raw TikTok industry label, e.g. label_14104000000
industryKey.title: Industry Key

landingPageUrl.description: Destination URL when the ad detail exposes it
landingPageUrl.title: Landing Page

objectives.description: Objective objects with key, name, and numeric id
objectives.title: Objectives

parentIndustryName.description: Parent industry name when the ad has a child category
parentIndustryName.title: Parent Industry

rank.description: Position on the board that surfaced the ad (1-based)
rank.title: Rank

retentionCurve.description: Per-second retention points {second, value} when keyframes are enabled
retentionCurve.title: Retention Curve

shareCount.description: Share count from the ad detail; 0 is a real value
shareCount.title: Shares

spotlightHighlight.description: TikTok expert commentary for Spotlight ads
spotlightHighlight.title: Spotlight Commentary

targetCountries.description: Countries from the ad detail's country_code list
targetCountries.title: Target Countries

videoId.description: TikTok video ID for the ad creative
videoId.title: Video ID

videoUrlsExpireAt.description: Earliest expiry of the signed media URLs (ISO 8601)
videoUrlsExpireAt.title: Media Expiry

voiceOver.description: Whether the ad detail reports a voice-over
voiceOver.title: Voice Over
